gloss: to stir up; to touch off; to create (a stir)

definitions.gloss: to stir up; to touch off; to whip up
definitions.explanation: To set off a reaction that spreads through a crowd or a society — debate, criticism, a craze, a sensation. The subject is usually a person, a work, or an event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{起|お}こす。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{起|お}こした。
examples.english: That remark touched off a major debate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦{界|かい}→界：09651_kai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ブーム→ブーム：05511_buumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{起|お}こして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A new director's film is setting off a boom in the movie world.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive. The reaction takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧; the person or thing that provokes it is the subject.
- The intransitive partner ⟦{巻|ま}き{起|お}こる→巻き起こる：07005_makiokoru⟧ means that the reaction arises by itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{起|お}こす: to touch off a debate
- {物議|ぶつぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{起|お}こす: to cause controversy
- ⟦ブーム→ブーム：05511_buumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{起|お}こす: to set off a craze
- {旋風|せんぷう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{起|お}こす: to create a whirlwind, to take the field by storm

What gets stirred up is nearly always a collective reaction, so a single small incident is ⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧, not {巻|ま}き{起|お}こす. The compound is ⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧ (to wind, to roll) + ⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ (to cause), and it is common in news writing.
